description: A prized relic long thought lost forever in a failed crusade.
tips: Holy Locket synergizes great with Mekansm, Guardian Greaves, Urn of Shadows and Spirit Vessel. Since it amplifies outgoing healing, all affected allies get healed for more.

abilities.description:
Target an allied unit to increase their incoming Heal Amplification by 15% for 4s and instantly restore 17 health and 15 mana per charge stored.

Automatically gains a charge every 10 seconds and whenever a visible enemy within 1200 range uses an ability.

name: Holy Locket
